summaries.summary: Amazon's privacy policy outlines extensive data collection practices for personalized shopping. They collect purchase history, browsing behavior, and device information. Data is shared with third-party sellers and used for targeted advertising.
key_points: Collects purchase history and browsing data

summaries.summary: Facebook's terms grant them broad rights to user content and data. They can use your content for advertising, share it with partners, and retain it even after account deletion. The policy includes mandatory arbitration for disputes.
key_points: Platform owns license to user content
Data shared with advertisers and partners

summaries.summary: Chase's privacy policy emphasizes security and regulatory compliance. They collect financial data for service provision and fraud prevention. Data sharing is limited to essential partners and regulatory requirements.

Spotify's privacy policy focuses on music preferences and listening habits. They collect usage data for personalized playlists and recommendations. Optional location data is used for regional content.
ProtonMail's privacy policy demonstrates strong commitment to user privacy. They use end-to-end encryption and collect minimal user data. No content scanning or data sharing for advertising.
